description: F# is a language built around functions and clear data shapes. It works with the .NET tools. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install the .NET SDK. Save each example as lesson.fsx and run dotnet fsi lesson.fsx.
versionNote: Examples use F# with .NET 8 or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Handle an absent value with F#
